drafter.private_reasoning: Keep the draft focused on reciprocal confidentiality protections, without introducing transaction economics or disclosing confidential negotiating authority. The firms’ referral relationship should not affect the client’s protections.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find proposed revisions clarifying the mutual confidentiality obligations, customary exclusions, permitted disclosures, and return or destruction of information. The revisions also distinguish the agreement’s term from the survival of confidentiality obligations and confirm that neither party is committed to a transaction. Please confirm the parties’ full legal names and preferred governing law.

edits.text: PARTIES. This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures (each, a “Party” and together, the “Parties”) and is effective on the date of the last signature below (the “Effective Date”). Each Party may act as a disclosing party or a receiving party.
edits.name: Parties and effective date

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE; CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. The Parties wish to evaluate and negotiate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a Party to the other Party in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is identified as confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure, including analyses derived from such information and the existence, status, and terms of the Parties’ discussions. Confidential Information excludes information the receiving Party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available without breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without a confidentiality obligation before disclosure; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without a confidentiality obligation; or (d) is independently developed without use of or reference to the Confidential Information.
edits.name: Purpose, definition, and exclusions

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. In consideration of the mutual promises herein, each receiving Party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care and no less care than it uses for its own similar confidential information. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its directors, officers, employees, and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Agreement or by professional duties of confidentiality. The receiving Party is responsible for breaches by those representatives. If disclosure is required by law, regulation, or legal process, the receiving Party may disclose only what is legally required and shall, to the extent legally permitted, give prompt advance notice and reasonable cooperation, at the disclosing Party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. The receiving Party shall promptly notify the disclosing Party of any unauthorized use or disclosure of which it becomes aware and take reasonable steps to mitigate it.
edits.name: Mutual protection and permitted disclosure

edits.text: 3. TERM; RETURN OR DESTRUCTION. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the Effective Date unless earlier terminated by either Party by written notice. The confidentiality and use restrictions survive for three years after termination or expiration; for information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, they survive for as long as that information remains a trade secret. On written request, the receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information, including copies and analyses, and confirm compliance in writing. It may retain copies required by law, regulation, or bona fide professional recordkeeping requirements, and copies in routine backups that cannot reasonably be separately deleted, subject in each case to the surviving confidentiality and use restrictions.
edits.name: Term, survival, and disposition

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES; NO TRANSACTION COMMITMENT. Each Party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure may cause irreparable harm for which damages may be inadequate. The disclosing Party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, subject to applicable law, in addition to other available remedies. Neither Party is obligated to disclose information, continue discussions, or enter into a transaction. No license or other intellectual property right is granted by disclosure. Any commitment to a transaction must be set out in a separate definitive agreement signed by both Parties.
edits.name: Remedies and no transaction commitment

receiver.message_back: Subject to confirmation of our client’s full legal name and governing-law preference, we propose five years’ survival for confidentiality and use restrictions (with the existing trade-secret protection preserved), return or destruction within ten business days of request with written certification, and retained copies remaining protected until destroyed and used solely for the applicable retention requirement. Please also add exclusive jurisdiction in the agreed forum and clarify that neither termination nor expiration releases either Party from liability for prior breaches.

drafter.private_reasoning: The proposed mutual protections are suitable for this NDA. Party identity, governing law, and forum remain subject to confirmation; the draft leaves those matters expressly open. No confidential transaction authority is included.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We have incorporated five-year survival, preserved trade-secret protection, added a ten-business-day return/destruction deadline with written certification, and clarified continuing protection and restricted use of retained copies. We have also preserved liability for prior breaches and added exclusive-jurisdiction language with placeholders for the agreed law and forum. Please confirm your client’s full legal name and proposed governing law and forum so those remaining points can be finalized.

edits.text: 3. TERM; RETURN OR DESTRUCTION. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the Effective Date unless earlier terminated by either Party by written notice. The confidentiality and use restrictions survive for five years after termination or expiration; for information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, they survive for as long as that information remains a trade secret. Within ten business days after receipt of the disclosing Party’s written request, the receiving Party shall return or destroy Confidential Information, including copies and analyses, and certify compliance in writing. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the receiving Party may retain copies required by law, regulation, or bona fide professional recordkeeping requirements, and copies in routine backups that cannot reasonably be separately deleted. All retained copies shall remain subject to this Agreement’s confidentiality and use restrictions until destroyed, notwithstanding any otherwise applicable survival period, and may be used solely to satisfy the applicable retention requirement or, for routine backups, maintained solely for backup retention and not accessed or used for any other purpose. Neither termination nor expiration releases either Party from liability for any prior breach of this Agreement.

5. GOVERNING LAW; EXCLUSIVE JURISDICTION. This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or relating to it shall be governed by the laws of [agreed jurisdiction], without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. Each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of [agreed courts and location] for any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement and waives any objection to venue or based on inconvenient forum in those courts.

receiver.message_back: The revised protections are acceptable in principle, subject to adding an express mutual right to seek injunctive or other equitable relief for actual or threatened breaches, subject to applicable law, and correcting the section numbering. We propose New York law and exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts located in Manhattan, subject to client approval, and will confirm our client’s full legal name before execution; neither party should execute with placeholders remaining.
